title: Recorder: automatic trim, autosaving edit modal, layouts decided by data
recommendation: Apply the auto trim silently with one "Restore full video" link and make the edit modal autosave like the recorder; hold the four-to-three layout merge until U01 click data shows which layout people pick, because nothing records the layout today.

questions.q: Auto trim applied silently with "Restore full video" as the only control?
questions.recommended: Yes. 6 users ever chose, and the handles stay for anyone who wants to adjust.

questions.q: Edit modal autosaves and loses Cancel?
questions.recommended: Yes. Same model as the recorder; Restore is the undo.

questions.q: Merge the two camera-plus-screen layouts now (which one?) or wait a month for the click data from U01?
questions.recommended: Wait. If William already knows he wants inset, merge now and skip the wait.
